Pseudocode is to be written to implement a queue Abstract Data Type (ADT) with items of the string data type. This will be implemented using the information in the table.

[[fig:f1]]

A constant, with identifier `MaxSize`, limits the size of the queue to 60 items.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Write the pseudocode to declare `MaxSize`, `FrontPointer`, `RearPointer`, `Length` and `Queue`.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Complete the following pseudocode for the function `Dequeue` to remove the front item from the queue.

```text
FUNCTION Dequeue RETURNS STRING
    DECLARE Item : STRING
    IF  > 0 THEN
        Item ←
        IF Length = 0 THEN
            CALL Initialise // reset the pointers
        ELSE
            IF FrontPointer > MaxSize THEN
                ← 1
            ENDIF
        ENDIF
    ELSE
        OUTPUT "The print queue was empty - error!"
        Item ← ""
    ENDIF
    RETURN Item
ENDFUNCTION
```

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain how a new element can be added to the queue if it is implemented using two stacks.
